item.title: Owners of West Kerry nursing home announce it will reopen in new year
item.description: The owners of a West Kerry nursing home have announced it will reopen in the new year. Ocean View Care Home in Camp was acquired by Riada Care Ltd in March. In August the facility was closed for electrical upgrades and building works, with residents temporarily relocated. item.title: Calls for plan to be developed for existing building as funding secured for new courthouse in Tralee
item.description: Now that funding has been allocated to build a new courthouse in Tralee, the Government must develop a plan for the future of the existing building. That’s the view of Minister of State and Independent TD Michael Healy-Rae. He was speaking after the Department of Justice confirmed it has been allocated funding to begin construction of a new courthouse in Tralee. item.title: South Kerry Board chair says new GAA report needs to get more radical in addressing rural depopulation
item.description: The GAA needs to get even more radical in addressing how falling birthrates in rural areas is affecting the traditional parish system. That’s according to Joe McCrohan who is chair of South Kerry GAA Board, and rural development officer with South Kerry Development Partnership. He was reacting to a new GAA report to address demographic problems affecting Gaelic games. item.title: Money mule avoids jail for role in scamming Kerry couple
item.description: A young man has received a suspended sentence for his role in a scam which defrauded a Kerry couple of over €5,000. 20-year-old Ryan Odusanya of Bremore Pastures Drive, Balbriggan, Dublin, acted as a money mule in the scam. An elderly couple from Kerry and a business owner from Galway were targeted. item.title: Norris dominates practice
item.description: Britain's Lando Norris has dominated practice ahead of Sunday's deciding Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. He set the fastest time in both of today's sessions - and will be crowned Formula One world champion with a top three finish in Sunday's race. McLaren team-mate - and title rival - Oscar Piastri was eleventh in the second run. Advertisement Max Verstappen, who can also catch Norris, was second.

item.title: Damian Kennedy appointed interim Irish High Performance head coach
item.description: Damian Kennedy has been appointed the interim High Performance head coach of the Irish boxing team. The Antrim man has three decades of experience with the IABA and headed up Northern Ireland's team for the 2022 Commonwealth Games. He steps into the role as the IABA search for Zaur Antia's permanent successor. Advertisement

item.title: Waterford make Conan Noonan their record signing
item.description: Waterford FC have made Conan Noonan their record signing. The midfielder has joined the Blues from Shamrock Rovers and has signed a three-year contract. Noonan, a Republic of Ireland under-21 international, says he's 'absolutely delighted' to move to the RSC on a permanent basis. item.title: An Post working to find new contractor for Ardfert Post Office
item.description: An Post says it's working to find a new contractor for Ardfert Post Office. Last year, the Ardfert Community Council took over the running of the post office on a temporary basis. However, this arrangement is coming to an end on December 15th. Advertisement Over 100 people attended a public meeting in the village last night in a bid to save the post office from closure. item.title: Commemoration in Tralee to mark 81st anniversary of death of Charlie Kerins
item.description: Kerry Sinn Féin is holding a commemoration this evening, to mark the 81st anniversary of the death of IRA volunteer Charlie Kerins. Advertisement Known as “The Boy from Tralee,” Kerins was executed in Mountjoy Jail on the 1st of December 1944 under orders from the de Valera government. The commemoration starts at the Pikeman Monument on Denny Street at 7pm, followed by a procession to the Charlie Kerins Monument on Strand Street. item.title: Kerry sign goalkeeper Harry Halwax
item.description: Kerry FC have signed goalkeeper Harry Halwax from Longford. The 23-year-old Dublin native made 42 appearances for the midlanders, and also has previous First Division experience with Cabinteely, where he played 13 league games in 2021. He has represented the Republic of Ireland at Under 16, 17 & 18 levels.
